_readme: Training spec for RL/train/Train.ps1. ASCII-safe keys only (report prose lives in .md). Numbers here are the frozen protocol: opponent=base, beamA=1200/beamB=800, seed split, lineup pools, phases.

beam._comment: candidate training beam reduced 1200 -> 400 per the measured beam sweep (26% less wall clock, no significant win-rate change on 8 paired games). Acceptance (phase 4) should still run at 1200. Individual configs may override with their own "beam" field (candidate side) or "beam_opp" field (opponent side); beam_opp defaults to this opponent value. The opponent side is the most expensive side of a game, so beam_opp is the lever to sweep first - see the oppbeam phase.
beam._beam_opp_rule: beam_opp must be > 0 and a multiple of 100 (validated at config resolve time, naming the offending config).

league._comment: Self-play mixing for coordinate ascent. A share of cells plays the PREVIOUS GENERATION instead of the fixed difficulty opponent, so improving the candidate also raises the bar it is measured against. Which cells are self-play is deterministic: sha256(run|config|seed|first) top 32 bits / 2^32 < self_play_fraction (see Test-LeagueSelfPlay), so the same cells stay self-play every generation and paired comparisons stay valid. The checkpoint's sha12 is part of the cell key, so updating the checkpoint invalidates exactly the old self-play rows and re-measures them.
league._checkpoint_rule: league.checkpoint MUST exist while self_play_fraction > 0: the runner throws instead of silently falling back to opp=base. It is written by the coordinate-ascent loop at the end of an accepted round.
league._fraction_rule: self_play_fraction must be in [0,1]; 0 disables self-play and makes the run a plain fixed-opponent run (the [league] line then says so).

seeds._comment: train and holdout are disjoint by construction; the script re-checks and refuses on overlap.

measurement._comment: first: p = player side moves first, e = enemy side moves first. a_side: which faction the candidate AI plays. Game count per config = |seeds| * |firsts| * |asides|.

lineups._comment: Deterministic round-robin 3v3 generator. round r = floor(seed/slots), slot j = seed mod slots, stride = train.strides[(r+j) mod n], members = (i*stride + r) mod pool_size for i=j,j+1,j+2. Every 49 consecutive slots sweep all 49 heroes; switching stride per round makes the train lineups cover every hero >= 3 times. Holdout strides were searched so no holdout lineup collides with a train lineup. version=v2: each seed gets an anchor sharing NO hero with its generated lineup (v1 had 23/120 train seeds with the same hero on both sides); v1 is retained ONLY to reproduce historical runs (pilot / inj / beamsweep). Even seed -> generated lineup takes the enemy side, odd seed -> the player side.

train._anchors_v2_comment: Small pools of low-HERO_VALUE heroes. The generator picks the first pool with no hero in common with the seed's generated lineup; a 2-hero pool against a 3-hero lineup always leaves at least one pool disjoint, so disjointness is guaranteed, not hoped for.

params._comment: Sensitivity sweep grid. mode=rel uses factor, mode=add uses step, mode=set uses value. Scores are the 12 keys AI_Battle.set_weights accepts.

phases._comment: Design only. Budgets are game counts; wall clock assumes the measured pilot seconds/game.

P1_sensitivity.goal: rank single-parameter effects, pick 3-8 real levers
P1_sensitivity.control: base re-measured on an independent 8-seed block (10113..10120) as the noise floor

P0_oppbeam.goal: pick the opponent-side beam before any theta work: the opponent side dominates wall clock, and 800 was never measured
P0_oppbeam.control: opp_800 reproduces the spec default (beamB 800), so it doubles as the control/consistency check
P0_oppbeam.decision: wall clock per game AND win rate per arm; keep the largest beam whose s/game is affordable and whose win rate does not move (a weaker opponent inflates the candidate's win rate - that is the trap)

P2a_theta.goal: tune the 12 score keys with HERO_VALUE pinned to the base table

P2b_hero.goal: tune HERO_VALUE only, theta frozen at the P2a winner

P3_joint.goal: joint micro-tuning of the surviving theta + hero coefficients

P4_acceptance.goal: one-shot holdout examination of the single frozen winner
P4_acceptance.gate: Wilson 95% lower bound > 0.5 on the holdout seed set AND the holdout lineup pool

acceptance.metric: win rate with draws counted as half a win (18W/14L/0D -> Wilson lo 0.3997; the 8W/6L baseline -> 0.3259)
acceptance.rule: rate_lo95 > 0.5 on the holdout seed set using the holdout lineup pool
acceptance.baseline_reference: N=14, 8W 6L, +10.6 pts/game, win rate 57.1%, Wilson lo 0.3277 (not significant)

phases_v2_design._status: DESIGN ONLY - not yet executed. Written 2026-09-14 for user review at breakfast.
phases_v2_design._why: Old plan tuned 61 knobs against a single fixed opponent (base difficulty-2). Two problems measured tonight: (a) opponent beam 100..800 makes no measurable difference to the candidate win rate (53.1/56.2/53.1/56.2 over 32 games each), so the fixed opponent is not what caps us - and a fixed opponent with a wrong forward model teaches the trainer to exploit its blind spots; (b) a fixed opponent saturates the signal once we pass it, while self-play always sits near 50%.

step0_fix_signal_first.goal: clean the residual diff family that biases the score signal itself (damage over-predicted by 1..4; counter-attack predicted then absent)
step0_fix_signal_first.evidence: monitor round 7: ~7 of ~11 events are this family
step0_fix_signal_first.gate: after the fix, rerun the full -All gate and the long random scan

step1_opponent_pool.goal: replace 'fixed base opponent' with a league
step1_opponent_pool.needs_code: RlTrain.ps1 currently takes ONE global opponent (spec.opponent). League = per-cell opponent selection + -wB injection for the cand-vs-cand path (opp=cand already supported by 对局.gd). No frozen file needs editing.
step1_opponent_pool.gate: small equivalence run: same cells serial vs parallel, and a 2-arm sanity run (self-play vs base) before any long run

step2_search.goal: screening then coordinate ascent, not 61 knobs at once
step2_search.phase_screen: P1 arms (22 configs x 32 games) -> keep only 3..6 levers whose paired delta-pts CI excludes 0
step2_search.phase_ascent: each round moves 1..2 parameters only, 96 games, accept only if paired delta-pts CI excludes 0; 10..20 rounds; every accepted step is a new named config (auditable)
step2_search.hero_coefficients: grouped by role (tank/dps/support) + a few high-impact heroes, never all 49 at once
step2_search.primary_metric: paired delta-pts per game (information per game ~3-5x that of win/loss); win rate is display only

league_ascent.goal: coordinate ascent against an opponent that gets stronger with us, instead of a fixed opponent we can overfit
league_ascent.round_structure: each round: 70% of cells self-play vs league.checkpoint, 30% vs the fixed difficulty arm (opp=base, beam_opp=100); accept a step only if paired delta-pts CI excludes 0 against BOTH arms
league_ascent.checkpoint_update: after the round, write the accepted candidate weights to RL/weights/league_current.json (that file is what the next round's self-play cells read)
league_ascent.why_deterministic_split: which cells are self-play is sha256(run|config|seed|first)-derived, so the same cells stay self-play across generations and the paired comparison stays valid; the checkpoint's sha12 enters the cell key, so a new checkpoint invalidates exactly the old self-play measurements
league_ascent.cost_note: self-play cells run opp=cand, i.e. both sides at beamA=400; the fixed arm runs opp=base at beam_opp=100 and is much cheaper, so a 70/30 round costs more per game than a P1 arm

step3_acceptance_panel.goal: one-shot holdout against a panel, not just the base opponent
step3_acceptance_panel.gate: Wilson 95% lower bound > 0.5 against both base arms AND > 0.5 against our own previous generation (the anti-self-deception check)
step3_acceptance_panel.holdout_discipline: holdout seed set + holdout lineup pool are still touched exactly once (existing guard)

beam_decisions_measured.opponent_evidence: 100/200/400/800 all within noise (53.1/56.2/53.1/56.2, N=32 each); injection proven by 14/10/10 of 32 games differing plus the pre-patch 800 arm matching 28/28
